description: This file implements concurrency debugging utilities, including tracking mutex contention times and logging stack traces when mutex acquisition takes longer than expected, enabled by SB_ENABLE_CONCURRENCY_DEBUG.

classes.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker
classes.description: A class that tracks the duration of mutex acquisition attempts and logs if the wait exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Constructor that attempts to acquire a mutex and records the start time if not immediately acquired.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::~ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Destructor that calculates wait time, updates maximum contention time, and logs details if wait exceeds threshold.
